info.name: Fcom Backend Tests
info.description:
Portable manual regression suite for Fcom backend - vanilla HTML/CSS/JS SPA plus Supabase Edge Functions.

Prerequisites:
1. Set `base_url` to the Edge Functions base URL.
2. Apply the required Supabase migrations before running backend tests.
3. Use seed.sql only in local/dev or disposable staging; never production.
4. Leave SMS_API_URL empty for dev OTP mode, or adjust OTP tests for a real SMS provider.
5. Set `supabase_url` and `supabase_anon_key` for direct PostgREST negative security checks.
6. Use an approved admin token for admin folders. Auth Setup captures `admin_token` from `alice` only when `alice.role === "admin"`; otherwise set `admin_token` manually.
7. For media upload, select a small local image file in MU-01 or set `media_file_path` in Postman.
8. Run folders in order: Auth Setup -> Registration -> OTP Verification -> Set Password -> Login / Logout -> Approve / Reject -> Messages -> Credo Rating -> Groups -> Media Upload -> Safety Reports / Blocks -> Admin Stats -> Group and Safety Table Security -> Security.

item.description: Direct PostgREST access must be blocked for group and safety tables. Successful writes should go through Edge Functions using service_role.
